preToolUse.bash: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.github/hooks" python3 -m agentwf hook pre

postToolUse.bash: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.github/hooks" python3 -m agentwf hook post

postToolUseFailure.bash: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.github/hooks" python3 -m agentwf hook post-failure
